title: Easy flat run + mobility
coachNotes: Flat only, no terrain, no descent. Its single job is to leave the legs intact for Sunday's 1100m climb block, the key session of the whole build. Friday's group run came in at 75 against a 100 estimate and at avg HR 136, so there is no case for adding volume back here: the marginal CTL is worth less than arriving at Sunday fresh. Gate: if HRV is under 52 or RHR is 52 or above Saturday morning, take full rest instead.
